original: That's weird... That should have\nbeen the exit...
We're trapped in here for real...
It must be the guy that Hackmon\nwas talking about! The one who\nbrought us here!
It really *is* you, Taichi! And\nyou're with Agumon!
I have no idea what you're talking\nabout!
Come on, Taichi, calm down! See?\nLook at my goggles!
They're the goggles you gave me!\nI'm Daisuke Motomiya, your junior!
...They're scratched in exactly\nthe same places as mine!
Don't you remember? Fifth-grader\nat Odaiba Elementary! Same class\nas Hikari and Takeru!
Wait, but isn't Takeru in second\ngrade?
Wait, what? That's not... huh?\nYou're shorter than I remember you\nbeing...
Daisuke! Oops, I think that was a\nbit too strong...
So you and V-mon are from three\nyears in the future, huh?
So the Taichi here is three years\nyounger than the Taichi I know...
I guess this dimension is\nconnected to other time periods,\ntoo...
So what are you gonna do now,\nDaisuke?
Isn't it obvious? I'm going with\nyou, Taichi!
I've always wanted to go on an\nadventure with you, like Hikari\nand Takeru did!
So now that that's decided, it's\ntime to go! Let's go, V-mon!
...so on our way back from school,\nwe were captured by a black\nshadow...
...and before we knew it, we were\nhere.
Something's been bothering me for\na while.
Would you and Daisuke be Agumon\nand V-mon's attendants?
No, no! Agumon's my friend... or\nmore like, my partner...
Hmmm? So then, why don't I have\none?
Well, when you put it that way...
In my time, I went to the Digital\nWorld, and I lifted up a\nDigimental...
Agumon and I met for the first\ntime at File Island.
I was a Koromon back then, though.
Okay, so why don't you become my\npartner, Taichi?
No can do! Taichi is *my* partner!
Then why don't we fight? Whoever\nwins gets to be Taichi's partner!
Hey, hey, don't just go off on\nyour own like that!
Is that a copy of me?
What are we gonna do, Taichi?
I mean, obviously we're gonna have\nto defeat him, right?
I know my limits! I'm not gonna\nfight someone way above my tier!
The heck is this? Are we gonna be\ntrapped here?
I can't really tell, but maybe\nthere's a door that'll only let us\nthrough.
So, got any ideas for these guys?\nThey're gonna be stuck here.
Nooooo! I thought I could finally\ngo on an adventure with Taichi!
There's gotta be a reason we can't\nget out of here.
If we both look for it, we'll run\ninto each other again at some\npoint!
Is it gonna be that easy?
The only thing we can do is\nbelieve!
Yeah, so let's meet up again\nlater!
Even back in elementary school,\nTaichi was still the same old\nTaichi...
